title: CultiVerse: Towards Cross-Cultural Understanding for Paintings with Large Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through user studies and semi-structured interviews where participants from diverse geographical and ethnic backgrounds assessed LLM-generated cultural norm translations, visual outputs, and symbolic associations for appropriateness, authenticity, and the presence of stereotypical impressions (e.g., associating Australia solely with kangaroos).

Observing system performance and user experience during open-ended exploration when participants queried the LLM using or about lesser-dominant languages and cultures (e.g., Tibetan, Nepali), noting disparities such as translation loss, long wait times, and incomprehensible errors compared to dominant languages.
